intro.text: One of the leaders of the Fused, who takes up residence in Kholinar Palace.

items.text: Hnanan was made one of the Fused by Odium thousands of years ago, and fought humankind in the Desolations; she ranks with the leaders of the Fused. After Kholinar fell, she lived in the king's chambers of the palace. At Odium's instruction she had Leshwi fetch Moash, then gave him a yellow-white knife and sent him to kill Jezrien in the Beggars' Porch.

appearance.text: She wears robes with a long train and rarely touches the ground, preferring to hover. She speaks Alethi with a strong accent, and her name is more a hum than a word.
